analyst_view.overall: Early view: NEC and Twente both play European games on Thursday 26 November, NEC at home to Rennes and Twente away at Freiburg, so both arrive with three days' rest on a Sunday night. NEC won their last two league games and beat Omonia 3-1, while Twente beat Excelsior 9-0 and were the better side in the 2-2 with Ajax.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.4 goals. I lean higher: Twente's attack with Wout Weghorst and Sondre Orjasaeter is the sharpest in the league right now, NEC's last two games finished 3-2 and 3-1, and tired legs after Thursday games usually make defending harder.

corners.text: The numbers say 10 corners, close to even. Twente cross a lot and NEC will attack at home, which already fits the estimate.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.2 cards. No rivalry, no bans in the news and two teams that both want the ball; I keep it.

shots.text: The numbers say 29.5 shots. Both sides attack, but fatigue from European games could cut both ways, more space but less intensity, so I keep the estimate.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.6 shots on target. I lean slightly higher because both attacks are in form, with Dusan Tadic scoring twice at Utrecht and Twente hitting the target often against Ajax.
